svg.title: Figure 17 · Sampling uncertainty in the tail
svg.desc: An IID nonparametric bootstrap of one 1,000-observation synthetic normal sample: 1,200 resamples, seed 4108. The bootstrap is conditional on the observed empirical distribution and cannot generate an unseen crisis.
